fields.value: Visualizing the alloying of Au-Pd core-shell nanoparticles using gas-phase in situ transmission electron microscopy under different gas atmospheres.
in situ STEM dataset of the alloying of Au-Pd core-shell nanoparticles under H2 or O2 at atmospheric pressure

dsDescriptionValue.value:
This repository contains the in situ gas-phase transmission electron microscopy dataset obtained for the publication below. 

The dataset contains images of the process of alloying of core-shell Au-Pd nanoparticles for 1h at 375 C under H2 and under O2. The project consisted on visualizing the changes in alloying dynamics under a reducing (H2) and an oxidizing (O2) gas atmosphere.

publicationCitation.value: In Situ Analysis of Gas Dependent Redistribution Kinetics in Bimetallic Au-Pd Nanoparticles, Marta Perxés Perich, Christopher R. O’Connor, Koen M. Draijer, Nienke L. Visser, Nongnuch Artrith, Christian Reece, Petra E. de Jongh, and Jessi E.S. van der Hoeven*
